title: Targeted capture of cpn60 gene fragments for PCR-independent microbial community profiling
protocol: Dilute sample genomic DNA to 2.5 ng/µl in 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0.
Add diluted sample to hydroshear tubes.
Sonicate the sample using high power, 30 cycles of 30 seconds on and 45 seconds off with cooling to 4°C.
Examine shearing results by running 1 µl of the sheared DNA on a High Sensitivity DNA kit for the Bioanalyzer.
Use further cycles in the hydroshear if necessary to achieve optimal fragment size around 200 bp, aiming for ~100-1000 bp range.
Concentrate the DNA using an Amicon YM-30 filter membrane to a volume of less than 60 μl.
Adjust the volume to 60 μl using water or 10 mM Tris-Cl pH 8.0.
Determine DNA concentration using the Qubit fluorometer BR kit, one replicate to preserve sample.
Record which Illumina index will be assigned to each sample for de-multiplexing after sequencing.
Add Illumina adaptors to the sample following the NEBNext Ultra DNA library prep kit protocol.
Use size selection to target 300-500 bp insert size (400-600 bp total library fragment size).
Use 35 μl of Ampure beads in the first bead selection and 25 μl in the second bead selection.
Add indices to the samples following NEBNext protocol section 2.4, using 10 cycles of PCR with recommended conditions.
Purify the adaptor-ligated DNA using Ampure beads as recommended.
Measure the DNA concentration using the Qubit HS kit with 2 µl.
Analyze 1 μl of a 1:5 dilution of adaptor-ligated, size-selected DNA using a Bioanalyzer HS DNA kit.
Determine the volume of DNA required to have 500 ng total.
Transfer the determined volume of DNA to a new Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Concentrate the DNA using a vacuum concentrator at high setting with heat to less than 3 µl.
Adjust the concentrated DNA volume to 3.4 μl with water.
Place the tubes on ice.
Follow the MYbaits User Manual (Version 1.3.7 - 10/30/2012) precisely for hybridization.
Hybridize the DNA for 24 hours.
Use Herculase II Fusion DNA polymerase or NEBNext High Fidelity PCR mastermix for post-capture amplification.
Ensure use of the universal primer and appropriate index primer from the NEBNext kit.
Perform 15 cycles of PCR using conditions specified in section A, step 8.
Purify the post-capture PCR product using Ampure beads as recommended in NEBNext protocol.
Determine DNA concentration using Qubit HS dsDNA kit.
Analyze a 1 µl sample from a 1:5 dilution with Bioanalyzer HS DNA chip.
Prepare a 4 nM pool using the DNA concentrations reported by the Bioanalyzer.
Dilute each sample to the appropriate concentration such that the final total is 4 nM.
Note that only 5 µl of the 4 nM pool is required for the sequencing reaction, but typically a much larger volume is prepared (e.g., 100-200 µl).
Use a final concentration of 8 pM of denatured library.
Include denatured phiX174 DNA at 12.5 pM if using V2 chemistry.
